title: The Blood Spiral/Quotes
summary:
"I think I broke off a bit of his ear... Is that bad?"
- Lok Lambert, about the petrified statue of Klaus

"I'm out of it for a little while and everyone gets delusions of grandeur!"
- Klaus to Dante Vale

"Believe it or not, Wilder, we're just here to talk."
- Lok Lambert to Wilder

"Why don't you take that picture with you?" (Sophie Casterwill)

"I don't need it." (Zhalia Moon) 

- Sophie Casterwill and Zhalia Moon, regarding the old photo of Zhalia with Klaus

"We've been waiting for you. How do you like Dark Dryad's trap?"
- Stack to the team

"Clever move, Dante Vale. Of course, I gave you that Titan myself so you could defeat the Professor for me. [...] Now I will take it from you."

- Rassimov to Dante Vale before permanently destroying Archwarder with Darkvoid

"We are the messengers of oblivion - part Seeker, part nightmare."
- Rassimov to Dante Vale

"Caliban...there's only one chance now." 
- Dante Vale to Caliban, as he struggles to get up off the floor after Rassimov's attack. 

"Blood Spirals. This must be true identity of the Casterwill Hunters, that have been after us for the past ten years."
- Dellix to Lane, Lucas Casterwill and Sophie Casterwill
